headings: ABSOLUTE LINEN SCENTED WARDROBE BAR PACK (PACK OF 4)

jsonld_raw.name: ABSOLUTE LINEN SCENTED WARDROBE BAR PACK (PACK OF 4)
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented ceramic wardrobe bars. They can be hung on the wardrobe rail, from hangers, or between clothes, even inside drawers.
Set of 4.

Absolute Linen | A fresh and luminous fragrance that instills a cozy atmosphere. The plant notes of fig and blackcurrant invigorate and awaken the senses. Floral heart notes blossom with the elegance of iris and rose. A pleasant trail of musky woods merges with the soft creamy tones of cedar wood and sandalwood.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, tangerine, blackcurrant, fig leaves.
Heart notes: iris, heliotrope, rose, white peach.
Base notes: sandalwood, cedar, musk, vanilla.
